description: Add an Incident Timeline feature that records and retrieves a chronological event log for each incident. Adds a timeline array to incidents in the data store, auto-records status changes, and exposes GET /api/v1/incidents/:id/timeline and POST /api/v1/incidents/:id/timeline/events endpoints. Add corresponding tests.
steps: Update src/data/store.js to add a 'timeline' array to each incident containing pre-seeded events (created, triage started, diagnosis complete, etc.).
Add GET /api/v1/incidents/:id/timeline endpoint in src/routes/incidents.js that returns the timeline array for a given incident, sorted newest-first. Support optional ?type= filter parameter.
Add POST /api/v1/incidents/:id/timeline/events endpoint in src/routes/incidents.js that allows adding custom timeline events (type, message, author fields required). Auto-generate id and timestamp.
Modify the existing acknowledge and resolve handlers to auto-append timeline events when incident status changes.
Add tests in tests/timeline.test.js covering: listing timeline events, filtering by type, adding custom events, auto-events on acknowledge/resolve, 404 for unknown incident.
acceptance_criteria: Status changes (acknowledge, resolve) auto-generate timeline events
Tests cover CRUD and auto-generation scenarios
verification: Review route handlers follow existing patterns in incidents.js
Confirm timeline data is properly structured in store.js
